behalf.zh: on behalf of / on one's behalf：代表（某人）、為了（某人）

ex.en: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
ex.zh: 我代表公司歡迎您。

ex.en: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
ex.zh: 請代我向你的家人問好。

ex.en: I thank you on behalf of my son.
ex.zh: 我代表我兒子向您道謝。

behalf.en: acting for someone or as their representative

ex.en: They sat on a park bench and began talking.
ex.zh: 他們坐在公園的長椅上，談起了話來。

ex.en: Tom sat on that park bench for nearly three hours.
ex.zh: 湯姆在公園的長椅上坐了將近三個小時。

ex.en: He and his friend sat on the bench.
ex.zh: 他和朋友坐在長椅上。

bench.en: a long seat for several people

ex.en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
ex.zh: 請事先告訴我行程。

ex.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
ex.zh: 萬一我不能來，我會事先打電話給你。

ex.en: It had been arranged beforehand.
ex.zh: 那件事已經事先安排好了。

beforehand.en: earlier than a particular time or event

ex.en: What's your favorite way to cook beans?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡用什麼方式煮豆子？

ex.en: Chocolate is made from cocoa beans.
ex.zh: 巧克力是用可可豆做的。

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西向全世界供應優質咖啡豆。

bean.en: a seed or pod of a plant, eaten as food

ex.en: I'm still a beginner.
ex.zh: 我還是個新手。

ex.en: This book is a good guide for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是很適合初學者的入門書。

ex.en: Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
ex.zh: 湯姆是新手，但他學得很快。

beginner.en: a person who has just started to learn something

ex.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
ex.zh: 規律運動有益健康。

ex.en: Walking is beneficial.
ex.zh: 走路對身體有益。

ex.en: The agreement is beneficial to both companies.
ex.zh: 這份協議對雙方公司都有利。

beneficial.en: helpful and having a good effect

ex.en: The app is still in beta.
ex.zh: 這個 App 還在測試階段。

ex.en: Sign up to test the beta version.
ex.zh: 報名試用測試版。

beta.en: a test version of software that is not yet finished

ex.en: Alpha, beta and gamma are Greek letters.
ex.zh: α、β 和 γ 都是希臘字母。

ex.en: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.zh: β 是希臘字母的第二個字母。

beta.en: the second letter of the Greek alphabet

ex.en: She thinks that happiness and health should be the benchmarks for success.
ex.zh: 她認為快樂與健康才是衡量成功的標準。

ex.en: This product has become the industry benchmark.
ex.zh: 這項產品已成為業界的標竿。

benchmark.en: a standard used to judge or compare other things

benchmark.zh: 以…為基準比較、做標竿評比

ex.en: We benchmark our prices against our competitors.
ex.zh: 我們以競爭對手為基準來比較價格。

ex.en: The team benchmarked the new software for speed.
ex.zh: 團隊對新軟體做了速度評比測試。

benchmark.en: to compare something with a standard to judge how good it is

ex.en: She is the sole beneficiary of the insurance policy.
ex.zh: 她是這張保單唯一的受益人。

ex.en: Small businesses are the main beneficiaries of the new law.
ex.zh: 小型企業是新法的主要受惠者。

beneficiary.en: a person who gets money or help from something

ex.en: The study looks at consumer behavioral patterns.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討消費者的行為模式。

ex.en: Behavioral changes take time.
ex.zh: 行為改變需要時間。

behavioral.en: relating to the way people or animals act

ex.en: Beef is usually more expensive than pork.
ex.zh: 牛肉通常比豬肉貴。

ex.en: Would you like some more beef?
ex.zh: 你要再來點牛肉嗎？

ex.en: I asked you to buy beef, not pork.
ex.zh: 我是叫你買牛肉，不是豬肉。

ex.en: We need to beef up security at the entrance.
ex.zh: 我們需要加強入口的保全。

ex.en: The company is beefing up its online marketing.
ex.zh: 公司正在加強網路行銷。

beef.en: to make something stronger or better

ex.en: I'm checking for laser beam alarm triggers.
ex.zh: 我在檢查有沒有雷射光束警報裝置。

ex.en: A beam of sunlight came through the window.
ex.zh: 一道陽光從窗戶照了進來。

ex.en: The old house has wooden beams on the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子的天花板上有木頭橫梁。

ex.en: The workers lifted a steel beam into place.
ex.zh: 工人把鋼梁吊到定位。

beam.en: a long thick piece of wood or metal that supports a roof or floor

ex.en: She beamed with pride at her son's graduation.
ex.zh: 她在兒子的畢業典禮上驕傲地笑開了。

ex.en: He beamed when he heard the good news.
ex.zh: 他聽到好消息時笑得合不攏嘴。

beam.en: to smile very widely because you are happy

be.zh: 是（連接主詞與身分、狀態）

ex.en: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
ex.zh: 我在你這個年紀時，冥王星還是行星。

ex.en: How could I be a robot? Robots don't dream.
ex.zh: 我怎麼可能是機器人？機器人不會做夢。

be.en: to link a subject with a description, identity or state

ex.en: The meeting room is on the third floor.
ex.zh: 會議室在三樓。

ex.en: Where was Tom last night?
ex.zh: 湯姆昨晚在哪裡？

be.en: to exist or to be in a place

ex.en: My manager is working on the new design.
ex.zh: 我的主管正在處理新的設計。

ex.en: The report was written by my manager.
ex.zh: 這份報告是我主管寫的。

be.en: used with another verb to show an ongoing action or an action done to someone

ex.en: The company is going to launch the product next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月要推出這項產品。

ex.en: Is it going to rain this afternoon?
ex.zh: 今天下午會下雨嗎？

be.en: used to say what you plan to do or what will happen

ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.
ex.zh: 你必須在截止日期前完成這項工作。

ex.en: You are always to knock before entering my room.
ex.zh: 進我房間前一定要先敲門。

before.en: earlier than a particular time or event

ex.en: It won't be long before we know the truth.
ex.zh: 真相很快就會揭曉。

ex.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請關燈。

before.en: earlier than the time when something happens

ex.en: You've been late for school more often than before.
ex.zh: 你上學遲到的次數比以前更多了。

ex.en: I've seen this movie before.
ex.zh: 我以前看過這部電影。

ex.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
ex.zh: 飛機開始震動時，乘客都緊張了起來。

ex.en: The older we become, the worse our memory gets.
ex.zh: 我們年紀越大，記憶力就越差。

become.en: to start to be in a certain state

ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
ex.zh: 那個窮苦的年輕人最後成為了偉大的藝術家。

ex.en: She became a manager last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升上經理。

become.en: to grow or change into something

ex.en: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
ex.zh: 如果我們早點開始，就能在午餐前完成。

ex.en: Mr Smith always begins his lectures with a joke.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生總是用笑話開始上課。

ex.en: The meeting will begin at nine.
ex.zh: 會議九點開始。

begin.en: to start doing something or to start to happen

begin.zh: from beginning to end：從頭到尾

ex.en: I found this book interesting from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 我覺得這本書從頭到尾都很有趣。

ex.en: The concert was great from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 這場音樂會從頭到尾都很精彩。

begin.en: during the whole of something, from first part to last

ex.en: To begin with, let me explain the plan.
ex.zh: 首先，讓我說明一下計畫。

ex.en: To begin with, the price is too high.
ex.zh: 首先，價格太高了。

begin.en: used to introduce the first point or reason

ex.en: I believed that he would keep his promise.
ex.zh: 我相信他會遵守諾言。

ex.en: I can't believe it!
ex.zh: 真不敢相信！

believe.en: to feel sure that something is true or that someone is telling the truth

ex.en: He believes that there is a spy among us.
ex.zh: 他認為我們當中有一個間諜。

ex.en: It is believed that whales have their own language.
ex.zh: 一般認為鯨魚有自己的語言。

believe.en: to think that something is true or likely

believe.zh: believe in：相信（…的存在或價值）

ex.en: I believe in hard work.
ex.zh: 我相信努力的價值。

ex.en: Do you believe in luck?
ex.zh: 你相信運氣嗎？

believe.en: to feel sure that something exists or is good

ex.en: Please bear with me until I finish the story.
ex.zh: 請耐心聽我把故事講完。

ex.en: I can't bear the noise from next door.
ex.zh: 我受不了隔壁的噪音。

ex.en: She couldn't bear to see him leave.
ex.zh: 她不忍心看他離開。

bear.en: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

bear.zh: 承受（重量）；負擔（費用、責任）

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 冰太薄，承受不了你的重量。

ex.en: The company will bear the cost of the repairs.
ex.zh: 公司將負擔維修費用。

bear.en: to hold up a weight, or to accept a cost or duty

ex.en: This tree bears good peaches every year.
ex.zh: 這棵樹每年都結出好吃的桃子。

ex.en: These trees bear fruit in late summer.
ex.zh: 這些樹在夏末結果。

bear.en: to produce fruit or flowers, or to give birth to a child

ex.en: Please bear in mind that the office closes at five.
ex.zh: 請記得辦公室五點關門。

ex.en: Bear in mind that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請記住價格可能會變動。

bear.en: to remember and think about something important

ex.en: We saw a bear near the campsite.
ex.zh: 我們在營地附近看到一隻熊。

ex.en: Bears sleep through most of the winter.
ex.zh: 熊大部分的冬天都在冬眠。

bear.en: a large heavy wild animal with thick fur

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: He looked at the pine tree behind the house.
ex.zh: 他望向房子後面的那棵松樹。

ex.en: A strange sound was heard from behind the door.
ex.zh: 門後傳來奇怪的聲音。

behind.en: at the back of someone or something

ex.en: Our project is behind schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的專案進度落後。

ex.en: Sales are behind last year's numbers.
ex.zh: 銷售額落後去年的數字。

ex.en: What was the reason behind his decision?
ex.zh: 他做這個決定背後的原因是什麼？

ex.en: The whole team is behind you.
ex.zh: 整個團隊都支持你。

behind.en: being the cause of something, or giving support to it

ex.en: We found the beds quite comfortable.
ex.zh: 我們覺得這些床很舒服。

ex.en: We have space for two beds.
ex.zh: 我們有空間放兩張床。

ex.en: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
ex.zh: 房間裡除了一張破舊的床，什麼都沒有。

bed.en: a piece of furniture that you sleep on

ex.en: It is time for you to go to bed.
ex.zh: 你該去睡覺了。

ex.en: The boy went to bed with his socks on.
ex.zh: 那個男孩穿著襪子就上床睡覺了。

bed.en: to get into a bed in order to sleep

ex.en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
ex.zh: 你的行為造成了很多問題。

ex.en: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
ex.zh: 醫生持續觀察病人的行為。

ex.en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.
ex.zh: 有些人覺得湯姆的行為不太恰當。

ex.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天低於零度。

ex.en: It is ten degrees below zero now.
ex.zh: 現在是零下十度。

ex.en: The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上氣溫降到零度以下。

below.en: lower than a number or standard

ex.en: The sun has just sunk below the horizon.
ex.zh: 太陽剛沉到地平線下。

ex.en: Please sign below the line.
ex.zh: 請在線的下方簽名。

below.en: in a lower place than something

ex.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
ex.zh: 關於下面的內容，我想確認兩件事。

ex.en: Please see the details below.
ex.zh: 詳情請見下方。

below.en: in a lower place, or later in a text

ex.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
ex.zh: 巴黎是世界上最美的城市。

ex.en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
ex.zh: 這些花插在花瓶裡會更好看。

ex.en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，那座島非常美。

ex.en: The beauty of that country is beyond description.
ex.zh: 那個國家的美難以言喻。

ex.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
ex.zh: 這超出了我的想像。

ex.en: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
ex.zh: 自己蓋房子超出了我的能力。

beyond.en: too far or too difficult for something

ex.en: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
ex.zh: 森林的另一邊有一座美麗的湖。

ex.en: There is a small village beyond the hills.
ex.zh: 山丘的另一邊有一個小村莊。

beyond.en: on the far side of something

ex.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
ex.zh: 我們必須團結起來才能打敗敵人。

ex.en: Our team beat them 3 to 1.
ex.zh: 我們隊以三比一打敗了他們。

beat.en: to win against someone in a game, fight or contest

ex.en: My heart beat when I heard my name called.
ex.zh: 聽到有人叫我的名字，我的心怦怦直跳。

ex.en: His heart stopped beating and he died immediately.
ex.zh: 他的心臟停止跳動，當場死亡。

beat.en: to make regular movements, as the heart does when it pumps blood

ex.en: She was humming a song in four beats.
ex.zh: 她哼著一首四拍子的歌。

ex.en: This song has a great beat.
ex.zh: 這首歌的節奏很棒。

beat.en: a regular pulse or rhythm in music

ex.en: This town has two beaches.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮有兩個海灘。

ex.en: He wanted to go to the beach with her.
ex.zh: 他想和她一起去海邊。

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 有些海灘沒有遵守環保法規。

beach.en: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea or a lake

ex.en: How do you know that belongs to Tom?
ex.zh: 你怎麼知道那是湯姆的？

ex.en: They said it belonged to them.
ex.zh: 他們說那是他們的。

ex.en: Which Buddhist school of thought do they belong to?
ex.zh: 他們屬於哪個佛教宗派？

belong.en: to be owned by someone or be part of a group

ex.en: Put the books back where they belong.
ex.zh: 把書放回原位。

ex.en: I finally feel like I belong here.
ex.zh: 我終於覺得自己屬於這裡。

belong.en: to have the right place or fit in a certain place or group

ex.en: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
ex.zh: 我堅信他是清白的。

ex.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.
ex.zh: 我相信知識就是力量。

ex.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡量避免把自己的想法強加在別人身上。

belief.en: a feeling that something is true or good, or trust in a religion

ex.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
ex.zh: 她除了是演員，還是一位著名的畫家。

ex.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
ex.zh: 除了鋼琴，你還會彈其他樂器嗎？

ex.en: There was no one there besides me.
ex.zh: 那裡除了我，一個人都沒有。

besides.en: used to add something to what has just been mentioned

ex.en: I don't want to go out. Besides, it's raining.
ex.zh: 我不想出門，而且外面在下雨。

ex.en: The hotel is too expensive. Besides, it's far from the station.
ex.zh: 那家飯店太貴了，而且離車站很遠。

besides.en: used to add another reason or point to what you have said

ex.en: This place is famous for its scenic beauty.
ex.zh: 這個地方以風景優美聞名。

ex.en: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
ex.zh: 那裡的景色美得難以形容。

beauty.en: the quality of looking very nice or pleasing to see

ex.en: She will be a beauty when she grows up.
ex.zh: 她長大後一定是個美女。

ex.en: His sister was a famous beauty.
ex.zh: 他姊姊是有名的美女。

beauty.en: a woman who is very attractive

ex.en: The beauty of this plan is that it's cheap.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的好處在於很便宜。

ex.en: The beauty of working from home is the flexibility.
ex.zh: 在家工作的好處是有彈性。

beauty.en: the best or most useful feature of something

ex.en: I bet ten dollars on that horse.
ex.zh: 我在那匹馬上押了十美元。

ex.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.
ex.zh: 我跟人打賭她會贏得比賽。

bet.en: to risk money on the result of a race, game or event

ex.en: I bet he will get mad.
ex.zh: 我敢說他一定會生氣。

ex.en: I bet Tom and Mary have never even been to Boston.
ex.zh: 我敢說湯姆和瑪麗根本沒去過波士頓。

bet.en: used to say you are quite sure that something is true

ex.en: I lost the bet and had to buy lunch.
ex.zh: 我打賭輸了，只好請吃午餐。

ex.en: They made a bet on the game.
ex.zh: 他們拿那場比賽打賭。

bet.en: an agreement to risk money on a result, or the money risked

ex.en: Two beers, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩杯啤酒。

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天喝生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: I've just eaten some sushi and drunk a beer.
ex.zh: 我剛吃了壽司，喝了一杯啤酒。

beer.en: a bitter alcoholic drink made from grain

ex.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?
ex.zh: 你受得了他的行為舉止嗎？

ex.en: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
ex.zh: 他為自己表現得那麼差勁感到非常羞愧。

ex.en: My computer is behaving strangely.
ex.zh: 我的電腦怪怪的。

behave.en: to act in a certain way, or to work in a certain way

ex.en: Please behave yourself at the party.
ex.zh: 在派對上請守規矩。

ex.en: The children behaved well during the trip.
ex.zh: 孩子們在旅途中都很乖。

behave.en: to act in a polite and correct way

ex.en: She bent down and picked up the coin.
ex.zh: 她彎下腰把硬幣撿起來。

ex.en: He has back pain, he can't bend over.
ex.zh: 他背痛，沒辦法彎腰。

ex.en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
ex.zh: 我不用彎膝蓋就能把手掌平貼在地上。

bend.en: to make something curved, or to lower the top part of your body

ex.en: Tom took the bend too fast and landed in the ditch.
ex.zh: 湯姆轉彎轉得太快，衝進了水溝。

ex.en: There's a sharp bend in the road ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路有個急彎。

bend.en: a curved part of a road or river

ex.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
ex.zh: 他費盡心思討好老婆。

ex.en: The staff bent over backwards to help us.
ex.zh: 員工們竭盡全力幫助我們。

bend.en: to try very hard to help or please someone

ex.en: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
ex.zh: 那些錢藏在地板下面。

ex.en: We sat beneath a big tree to rest.
ex.zh: 我們坐在一棵大樹下休息。

ex.en: The ground beneath our feet began to shake.
ex.zh: 我們腳下的地面開始搖晃。

beneath.en: in a lower place than something, or under it

ex.en: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
ex.zh: 那條皮帶成了我恐懼的象徵。

ex.en: These pants are too big; I need a belt.
ex.zh: 這條褲子太大了，我需要一條皮帶。

belt.en: a band of leather or cloth worn around the waist

ex.en: Drivers should wear seat belts.
ex.zh: 駕駛應該繫安全帶。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

belt.en: a strap that holds you in your seat in a car or plane

belt.zh: tighten one's belt：勒緊褲帶、節省開支

ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
ex.zh: 中小企業必須勒緊褲帶才能生存。

ex.en: We need to tighten our belts this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年得勒緊褲帶。

belt.en: to spend less money because there is less available

ex.en: The bell rang and the train moved off.
ex.zh: 鈴聲一響，火車就開動了。

ex.en: In case of fire, ring the bell.
ex.zh: 萬一發生火災，請按鈴。

ex.en: The school bell rings at eight.
ex.zh: 學校的鐘聲八點會響。

bell.en: a metal object that makes a ringing sound, or the sound itself

ex.en: The name rang a bell in me.
ex.zh: 這名字聽起來很耳熟。

ex.en: His name rings a bell, but I can't remember his face.
ex.zh: 他的名字聽起來很耳熟，但我想不起他的長相。

bell.en: to sound familiar, so that you seem to remember it

ex.en: I know that Tom is allergic to bees.
ex.zh: 我知道 Tom 對蜜蜂過敏。

ex.zh: 我們遭到一大群蜜蜂攻擊。

ex.en: A bee stung me on the arm.
ex.zh: 一隻蜜蜂螫了我的手臂。

bee.en: a flying insect that makes honey and can sting

bee.zh: as busy as a bee：非常忙碌

ex.en: You are always as busy as a bee.
ex.zh: 你總是忙得團團轉。

ex.en: You're always as busy as a bee.
ex.zh: 你總是忙得像蜜蜂一樣。

bee.en: always working and having a lot to do

bee.zh: （拼字等）比賽、聚會（如 spelling bee）

ex.en: Amy won the school spelling bee.
ex.zh: Amy 贏得了學校的拼字比賽。

ex.en: My son is practicing for the spelling bee.
ex.zh: 我兒子正在為拼字比賽練習。

bee.en: a contest or gathering where people compete in a skill

ex.en: What's your favorite beverage?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡的飲料是什麼？

ex.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

ex.en: What beverages do you like to drink?
ex.zh: 你喜歡喝什麼飲料？

beverage.en: a drink such as water, juice or tea

ex.en: Our house has three bedrooms.
ex.zh: 我們家有三間臥室。

ex.en: The bedrooms are upstairs.
ex.zh: 臥室在樓上。

ex.en: Is there a television set in your bedroom?
ex.zh: 你臥室裡有電視嗎？

bedroom.en: a room in a house where you sleep

ex.en: The complicated map bewildered the tourists.
ex.zh: 複雜的地圖讓遊客一頭霧水。

ex.en: His sudden anger bewildered his family.
ex.zh: 他突如其來的憤怒讓家人困惑不已。

bewilder.en: to make someone feel very confused

ex.en: He beguiled the old woman into giving him all her savings.
ex.zh: 他誘騙那位老婦人把所有積蓄都給了他。

ex.en: She was beguiled by his charming smile and sweet words.
ex.zh: 她被他迷人的笑容和甜言蜜語迷住了。

beguile.en: to trick someone, or to attract someone strongly

ex.en: The old man walked slowly with a bent back.
ex.zh: 那位老先生駝著背慢慢地走。

ex.en: He is bent on winning the championship this year.
ex.zh: 他一心要在今年拿下冠軍。

bent.en: not straight, or very determined to do something

bent.zh: 彎（腰）、彎曲（bend 的過去式）

ex.en: She bent down and picked up the coin.
ex.zh: 她彎下身子，把硬幣撿了起來。

ex.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
ex.zh: 湯姆彎下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

bent.en: to have lowered the upper body forward from the waist

ex.en: Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.
ex.zh: 這本書是暢銷書。

ex.en: The new model became a bestseller within a month.
ex.zh: 這款新機上市一個月內就成了暢銷商品。

bestseller.en: a product, especially a book, that many people buy

ex.en: We are behind schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的進度落後了。

ex.en: They're 30 minutes behind schedule.
ex.zh: 他們比預定時間落後了 30 分鐘。

ex.en: The bus was behind schedule.
ex.zh: 公車誤點了。

ex.en: There are lots of benefits from travelling abroad.
ex.zh: 去國外旅行有很多好處。

ex.en: Does doing things in this way have a benefit?
ex.zh: 這麼做有什麼好處嗎？

benefit.en: a good or helpful result or advantage

ex.en: This event benefits no one.
ex.zh: 這件事對誰都沒有好處。

ex.en: Who benefits from it?
ex.zh: 這對誰有好處？

benefit.en: to help someone, or to get an advantage from something

ex.en: The company offers good benefits, including health insurance.
ex.zh: 這家公司福利很好，包括健康保險。

ex.en: Benefits include paid leave and an annual bonus.
ex.zh: 福利包括帶薪假和年終獎金。

benefit.en: extra things an employer gives workers besides pay

ex.en: This is the best coffee shop in our town.
ex.zh: 這是我們鎮上最好的咖啡店。

ex.en: She is my best friend from high school.
ex.zh: 她是我高中時期最好的朋友。

ex.en: Which season do you like best?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪個季節？

ex.en: Do what you think is best.
ex.zh: 做你認為最好的事。

ex.en: Let's hope for the best tomorrow.
ex.zh: 希望明天一切順利。

ex.en: She always wants the best for her children.
ex.zh: 她總是希望給孩子最好的。

ex.en: This phone is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 這支手機比我的舊手機好。

ex.en: I feel much better after a good sleep.
ex.zh: 睡了好覺之後，我覺得好多了。

ex.en: You should speak more slowly so people understand you better.
ex.zh: 你應該說慢一點，大家才能更了解你。

ex.en: He plays the piano better than I do.
ex.zh: 他鋼琴彈得比我好。

ex.en: The teacher praised the children for their good behaviour.
ex.zh: 老師稱讚孩子們的良好行為。

ex.en: His behaviour at dinner surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時的舉止讓大家很驚訝。

ex.en: The beginning of the movie was a little slow.
ex.zh: 電影的開頭有點慢。

ex.en: At the beginning of the year, I made a plan.
ex.zh: 年初的時候，我訂了一個計劃。

ex.en: This is only the beginning.
ex.zh: 這只是個開始。

ex.en: An old man was begging for food outside the station.
ex.zh: 一位老先生在車站外乞討食物。

ex.en: The dog sat by the table and begged for scraps.
ex.zh: 狗坐在桌邊討食物殘渣。

ex.en: I beg you to tell me the truth.
ex.zh: 我求你告訴我實話。

ex.en: She begged her parents to let her go to the concert.
ex.zh: 她懇求父母讓她去聽演唱會。

ex.en: The baby laughed and patted his round belly.
ex.zh: 寶寶笑著拍拍他圓圓的肚子。

ex.en: I have a pain in my belly after eating too fast.
ex.zh: 我吃得太快，肚子有點痛。

ex.en: The beast roared and ran back into the forest.
ex.zh: 那頭野獸吼了一聲就跑回森林裡。

ex.en: Children were afraid of the beast in the old story.
ex.zh: 孩子們害怕那個老故事裡的野獸。

beast.zh: 殘暴的人；很強悍的人事物

ex.en: He is a beast on the basketball court.
ex.zh: 他在籃球場上強悍得像頭野獸。

ex.en: Don't be such a beast to your little brother.
ex.zh: 不要對你弟弟那麼兇殘。

ex.en: My uncle grew a long beard last winter.
ex.zh: 我叔叔去年冬天留了長鬍子。

ex.en: He shaves his beard every week.
ex.zh: 他每週都刮鬍子。

ex.en: She cried when her beloved dog passed away.
ex.zh: 她心愛的狗過世時，她哭了。

ex.en: He is a beloved teacher at our school.
ex.zh: 他是我們學校深受喜愛的老師。

ex.en: He would never betray a friend for money.
ex.zh: 他絕不會為了錢出賣朋友。

ex.en: She felt betrayed when he told her secret to others.
ex.zh: 他把她的祕密告訴別人，讓她覺得被背叛了。

ex.en: His shaking voice betrayed how nervous he was.
ex.zh: 他顫抖的聲音洩漏了他有多緊張。

ex.en: Her smile betrayed her excitement about the trip.
ex.zh: 她的笑容透露出她對這趟旅行的興奮。

ex.en: She sings beautifully, and everyone loves her voice.
ex.zh: 她唱得很好聽，大家都喜歡她的聲音。

ex.en: The room was beautifully decorated for the party.
ex.zh: 房間為了派對布置得很漂亮。

ex.en: The sun set beautifully over the sea.
ex.zh: 夕陽在海面上美麗地落下。

ex.en: The new system works beautifully so far.
ex.zh: 新系統到目前為止運作得非常順利。

ex.en: Everything went beautifully at the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚禮上一切都進行得非常順利。

ex.en: I stayed home because I was sick.
ex.zh: 我因為生病所以待在家裡。

ex.en: She is happy because she passed the exam.
ex.zh: 她很開心，因為她通過了考試。

ex.zh: 因為時間已晚，我們搭計程車回家。

ex.en: The bank is between the post office and the library.
ex.zh: 銀行在郵局和圖書館之間。

ex.en: I usually have lunch between twelve and one.
ex.zh: 我通常在十二點到一點之間吃午餐。

ex.en: There is a big difference between these two phones.
ex.zh: 這兩支手機之間有很大的差別。

ex.en: She sat beside her brother on the sofa.
ex.zh: 她坐在沙發上她哥哥的旁邊。

ex.en: There is a small garden beside the library.
ex.zh: 圖書館旁邊有一座小花園。

ex.en: Put your bag beside the door so you won't forget it.
ex.zh: 把你的包包放在門旁邊，這樣才不會忘記。

ex.en: The sound of the alarm brought me into full being again.
ex.zh: 鬧鐘聲讓我完全清醒過來。

ex.en: The company came into being in the early twenty-first century.
ex.zh: 這間公司在二十一世紀初成立。

ex.en: A human being needs water, food, and sleep to stay healthy.
ex.zh: 人類需要水、食物和睡眠才能保持健康。

ex.en: She believed there was a higher being watching over the world.
ex.zh: 她相信有一個更高的存在在守護著世界。

being.zh: be 的現在分詞（正在…、因為是…）

ex.en: The kids are being very quiet this morning.
ex.zh: 孩子們今天早上表現得非常安靜。

ex.en: Being late again, he ran all the way to the office.
ex.zh: 因為又遲到了，他一路跑到辦公室。

belfast.zh: 貝爾法斯特（北愛爾蘭首府）

ex.zh: 貝爾法斯特是北愛爾蘭的首府。

ex.zh: 一艘著名的大船是在貝爾法斯特的造船廠建造的。

ex.zh: 班是班傑明這個名字的簡稱。

ex.zh: 我們花了一個長週末在柏林參觀博物館。

ex.zh: 伯納德每天傍晚都會幫陽台上的植物澆水。

ex.zh: 伯納德是我們這群人裡比較安靜的一個。

ex.en: Benjamin is a name that comes from Hebrew.
ex.zh: 班傑明這個名字源自希伯來文。

ex.zh: 班傑明·富蘭克林是作家、科學家，也是發明家。

ex.zh: 比利時是西歐的一個小國。

ex.zh: 比利時以巧克力和鬆餅聞名。

ex.zh: 貝蒂是伊莉莎白的暱稱。

ex.zh: 貝蒂是個老派的女孩名字。

ex.zh: 他的意見對最後的決定沒有影響。

ex.en: The weather has a direct bearing on how many people come.
ex.zh: 天氣和來的人數有直接關係。

ex.zh: 那位年輕軍官舉止沉穩而有威嚴。

ex.zh: 她帶著老師般沉靜的舉止。

ex.zh: 沒有地圖，我們很快就在森林裡迷失了方向。

ex.en: The captain checked the ship's bearing on the compass.
ex.zh: 船長用羅盤確認了船的方位。

ex.zh: 她把五顏六色的珠子串在一條細線上。

ex.zh: 這條項鍊是用小玻璃珠做成的。

ex.en: A bead of sweat ran down his face.
ex.zh: 一滴汗珠從他臉上滑落。

ex.en: Beads of water gathered on the cold glass.
ex.zh: 冰涼的杯子上凝聚了一顆顆水珠。

ex.en: She is a devoted believer and goes to church every week.
ex.zh: 她是個虔誠的信徒，每週都去教堂。

ex.en: The believers gathered to pray together.
ex.zh: 信徒們聚在一起祈禱。

ex.en: I am a great believer in getting enough sleep.
ex.zh: 我非常相信要有充足的睡眠。

ex.en: He used to doubt the plan, but now he is a believer.
ex.zh: 他以前懷疑這個計畫，現在卻成了支持者。

ex.en: The doctor suggested behavioural therapy to help him manage his anxiety.
ex.zh: 醫生建議他接受行為治療來幫助他控制焦慮。

ex.en: The teacher noticed some behavioural problems in the class.
ex.zh: 老師注意到班上有一些行為問題。

ex.zh: 那部老電影裡有個男人被敵人狠狠毒打的情節。

ex.zh: 那隻狗身上留著多年被毆打的痕跡。

ex.zh: 我們的隊伍在決賽中慘敗。

ex.zh: 股市本週遭受重挫。

ex.en: The doctor listened to the beating of my heart.
ex.zh: 醫生聽了我的心跳聲。

ex.en: The steady beating of the drums filled the hall.
ex.zh: 穩定的鼓聲迴盪在大廳裡。

ex.en: We picked a basket of berries at the farm.
ex.zh: 我們在農場摘了一籃莓果。

ex.en: This berry is sweet, but that one is sour.
ex.zh: 這顆莓果很甜，但那顆很酸。

ex.en: Birds eat the red berries that grow on the bush.
ex.zh: 鳥兒會吃灌木上長出來的紅色漿果。

ex.zh: Bennett 可以當名字，也可以當姓氏。

ex.zh: 班尼特在街對面向我們揮手。

ex.en: Belgian chocolate is famous around the world.
ex.zh: 比利時巧克力聞名全世界。

ex.zh: 我們早餐吃了配草莓的比利時鬆餅。

ex.zh: 我的室友是比利時人，會說三種語言。

ex.en: The Belgians celebrate their national day in July.
ex.zh: 比利時人在七月慶祝他們的國慶日。

ex.en: The doctor said the lump was benign and not dangerous.
ex.zh: 醫生說那個腫塊是良性的，不危險。

ex.en: A benign tumor usually does not spread to other parts of the body.
ex.zh: 良性腫瘤通常不會擴散到身體其他部位。

ex.en: The old man had a benign smile that made children feel safe.
ex.zh: 那位老先生有著和藹的笑容，讓孩子們覺得安心。

ex.en: The weather was benign all week, with no storms at all.
ex.zh: 整週天氣都很宜人，一點暴風雨也沒有。

ex.en: A shiny green beetle crawled across the leaf.
ex.zh: 一隻閃亮的綠色甲蟲爬過葉子。

ex.zh: 男孩把一隻甲蟲養在玻璃罐裡。

ex.zh: 農夫在他的小農場養巴克夏豬。

ex.zh: 巴克夏豬的豬肉因風味濃郁而受歡迎。

ex.en: He felt a deep sense of betrayal when his best friend lied to him.
ex.zh: 最好的朋友對他說謊，讓他深深感到被背叛。

ex.en: Telling her secret to others was a betrayal of trust.
ex.zh: 把她的祕密告訴別人是辜負了她的信任。

ex.en: Beirut is the capital of Lebanon.
ex.zh: 貝魯特是黎巴嫩的首都。

ex.en: Beirut sits on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
ex.zh: 貝魯特位於地中海沿岸。

ex.en: Beware of the dog.
ex.zh: 小心有狗。

ex.en: You should beware of strangers who ask for money online.
ex.zh: 你應該提防在網路上要錢的陌生人。

ex.en: She sat at his bedside until he fell asleep.
ex.zh: 她坐在他的床邊，直到他睡著。

ex.en: A glass of water stood at the bedside.
ex.zh: 床邊放著一杯水。

ex.en: I keep a bedside lamp for reading at night.
ex.zh: 我留著一盞床頭燈，方便晚上看書。

ex.en: The nurse has a very kind bedside manner.
ex.zh: 那位護理師在病人床邊的態度非常親切。

ex.en: She beckoned the waiter to bring the bill.
ex.zh: 她招手請服務生把帳單拿來。

ex.en: He beckoned me over with a wave of his hand.
ex.zh: 他揮手示意我過去。

ex.zh: 忙了一週的工作後，陽光海灘在向我們招手。

ex.en: Bright lights beckoned travelers into the small town.
ex.zh: 明亮的燈光吸引旅人走進小鎮。

ex.en: The tourists looked bewildered by the busy train map.
ex.zh: 遊客們看著複雜的火車路線圖，一臉困惑。

ex.en: He gave me a bewildered look when I asked the question.
ex.zh: 我問他那個問題時，他露出一臉茫然的表情。

ex.en: She felt bewildered by all the sudden changes.
ex.zh: 面對所有突如其來的變化，她感到不知所措。

ex.en: A large beech grows in front of the old school.
ex.zh: 一棵高大的山毛櫸長在老學校前面。

ex.en: The furniture is made of polished beech wood.
ex.zh: 這套家具是用拋光的山毛櫸木做的。

ex.en: Beethoven was a German composer.
ex.zh: 貝多芬是德國作曲家。

ex.en: We listened to a piece by Beethoven in music class.
ex.zh: 我們在音樂課上聆聽了貝多芬的一首作品。

ex.zh: 請隨時將您的隨身物品帶在身邊。

ex.zh: 她打包好自己的東西，搬到一座新城市。

ex.zh: 我弟弟的就寢時間是九點。

ex.zh: 媽媽每晚睡前都會唸故事給我們聽。

ex.en: It's past your bedtime, so go brush your teeth.
ex.zh: 已經過了你的就寢時間，去刷牙吧。

ex.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
ex.zh: 北京是中國的首都。

ex.en: We flew from Taipei to Beijing for a business meeting.
ex.zh: 我們從台北飛到北京參加商務會議。

ex.en: The university will bestow an honorary degree on the writer.
ex.zh: 大學將授予那位作家榮譽學位。

ex.en: The king bestowed a medal on the brave soldier.
ex.zh: 國王把一枚勳章授予那位勇敢的士兵。

ex.en: The soup turned bright red because of the beet.
ex.zh: 這道湯因為甜菜根而變成鮮紅色。

ex.en: Grandpa grows beets and carrots in his garden.

ex.en: He felt beholden to the family who had taken him in.
ex.zh: 他覺得自己對收留他的那家人有所虧欠。

ex.en: The crowd went berserk when the band came on stage.
ex.zh: 樂團登台時，群眾瘋狂起來。

ex.en: The dog went berserk at the sound of fireworks.
ex.zh: 聽到煙火聲，那隻狗變得狂躁不安。

ex.en: Technical problems continue to bedevil the project.
ex.zh: 技術問題持續困擾著這個專案。

ex.en: Bad weather has bedeviled the team all season.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣整季都在困擾這支球隊。

ex.en: The beaming bride waved to the guests.
ex.zh: 笑容滿面的新娘向賓客揮手。

ex.en: He came home with a beaming smile after the good news.
ex.zh: 聽到好消息後，他笑容滿面地回到家。

ex.en: They bought a small house on the beachfront.
ex.zh: 他們在海濱買了一間小房子。

ex.en: The beachfront is crowded with tourists in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天海濱擠滿了遊客。

ex.en: We stayed in a beachfront hotel with a lovely view.
ex.zh: 我們住在一間臨海的旅館，景色很美。

ex.en: Beachfront property is usually very expensive.
ex.zh: 海濱的房地產通常非常昂貴。

ex.en: They visited a Benedictine monastery in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他們參觀了山上的本篤會修道院。

ex.en: The Benedictine monks make their own bread.
ex.zh: 本篤會的修士自己做麵包。

ex.en: Violence often begets more violence.
ex.zh: 暴力往往會引來更多暴力。

ex.en: In the old story, the king begot three sons.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，國王生了三個兒子。

ex.en: Our beagle follows every smell down the street.
ex.zh: 我們家的米格魯會循著每一種氣味一路走在街上。

ex.en: The beagle has long floppy ears and a loud bark.
ex.zh: 米格魯有長長的垂耳和響亮的叫聲。

ex.en: A bevy of reporters waited outside the court.
ex.zh: 一群記者在法院外等候。

ex.en: She arrived with a bevy of friends carrying gifts.
ex.zh: 她和一群帶著禮物的朋友一起抵達。

ex.en: The bespectacled boy sat at the front of the class.
ex.zh: 戴眼鏡的男孩坐在教室前排。

ex.en: A bespectacled librarian helped me find the book.
ex.zh: 一位戴眼鏡的圖書館員幫我找到那本書。

ex.en: He used bellows to make the fire burn stronger.
ex.zh: 他用風箱讓火燒得更旺。

ex.en: The old accordion has leather bellows.
ex.zh: 這把老手風琴有皮製的風箱。

ex.en: I don't begrudge you your success; you worked hard.
ex.zh: 我不嫉妒你的成功，你確實很努力。

ex.en: He begrudged every dollar he spent on the repairs.
ex.zh: 他對修理花的每一塊錢都心疼不已。

ex.en: She has a beguiling smile that makes people trust her.
ex.zh: 她有著迷人的笑容，讓人容易信任她。

ex.en: The beguiling smell of fresh bread filled the street.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包誘人的香味瀰漫整條街。

ex.en: The singer's voice seemed to bewitch the whole audience.
ex.zh: 歌手的嗓音彷彿迷住了全場觀眾。

ex.en: In the tale, the old woman bewitched the prince.
ex.zh: 在故事裡，老婦人對王子施了魔法。

bethlehem.zh: 伯利恆（位於中東的城市，傳統上被視為耶穌的誕生地）

ex.en: Bethlehem is a city in the West Bank.
ex.zh: 伯利恆是約旦河西岸的一座城市。

ex.en: Many pilgrims travel to Bethlehem at Christmas.
ex.zh: 許多朝聖者在聖誕節時前往伯利恆。
